current_activity: General Priess and the XIII SS Corps take command in the sector east of Nancy
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 5 p. 236: "At the same time General Priess and the XIII SS Corps took command east of Nancy"; the sentence belongs to the 24 September attack of the First Army. Event definition: the corps takes over the sector, with the 559th Volksgrenadier Division; the exact day is the day of the First Army attack (24 September), so the date is approximate. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Nancy with a precision of 25 km, because the source says "east of Nancy". Location approximate: a sector point; no corps headquarters place is given. Location support: CMH gives the direction from Nancy only. Commander: General Priess. Context: the Lexikon lists the 462nd Division under the XIII SS Corps, First Army, in September.

current_activity: Priess attacks toward Moncel with the 559th Volksgrenadier Division and the 106th Panzer Brigade
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 5 p. 245-246: Knobelsdorff "ordered General Priess, who, as commander of the XIII SS Corps, was directing operations in this sector, to throw everything he had into a resumption of the attack on 27 September"; "Priess selected the village of Moncel, on the Nancy-Dieuze highway, as the initial objective". Event definition: the attack of 27 September; it failed against the 35th Infantry Division. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Château-Salins with a precision of 10 km; the attack went down the Chambrey-Pettoncourt road toward Moncel, and the corps headquarters is not placed. Location approximate: a sector point for the attack area. Location support: CMH names the road and the objective. Commander: General Priess. Opponents: US 35th Infantry Division.

current_activity: XIII SS Corps holds from the Moselle at Metz to the Seille and receives the 21st Panzer and 36th VG Divisions
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 7 p. 365: "The XIII SS Corps was in a precarious tactical position, attempting to hold with its right wing on the Moselle River--at Metz--and with its left at the Seille River line"; "The XIII SS Corps received more substantial reinforcements on 13 November". Event definition: the reinforcement of 13 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Metz with a precision of 25 km, the right end of the corps front; the left end was the Seille line. Location approximate: a representative point for the corps front. Location support: CMH names Metz and the Seille line. Commander: Generalleutnant der Waffen-SS Hermann Priess. Opponents: US XII Corps and XX Corps.
